description: This file defines the Clipboard interface and its nested ClipboardUpdatedListener interface, specifying methods for clipboard management such as retrieving text, checking if clipboard is empty, deleting entries, and setting update listeners.

classes.name: Clipboard
classes.description: Interface for clipboard operations, including retrieving text, counting entries, checking if empty, deleting entries, and setting update listeners.

classes.name: Clipboard.ClipboardUpdatedListener
classes.description: Listener interface for clipboard updates, with methods called when an entry is added or the clipboard is cleared.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text at the specified entry index in the clipboard.

methods.name: getClipboardEntriesCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of entries in the clipboard.

methods.name: isOsClipboardEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the OS clipboard is empty.

methods.name: deleteEntry
methods.description: Deletes the clipboard entry at the specified index.

methods.name: deleteAllEntries
methods.description: Deletes all entries from the clipboard.

methods.name: setClipboardUpdatedListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to be notified of clipboard updates.
